body:
`robofab-insert` (robofab track, milestone 2): CEM-tuned planar peg-in-hole search policies in MuJoCo, trained on three fidelity levels or with domain randomisation, tested on all three plus a held-out parameter set. Stylised, sim-to-sim only; 6 tests; `python site/build.py` prints `ok`. Two citations (Tobin 2017, Rubinstein 1999) were added from memory and are flagged unverified in the README.
